newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Salomon cuts Hungary MOL to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: Salomon cuts Hungary MOL to hold from buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Wednesday it had cuts its rating for Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt to hold from buy.
"MOL has breached our $20 target price and the shares stand slightly above fair value on a short-term basis," Salomon Brothers said in a research report from its global energy team in London.
"Its sector peers have slightly outperformed a rising European equity market since we last assessed MOL's value, and this has presented part of the gap," the report added.
It said that neither Austrian oil group OMV AG nor Spain's Cepsa were likely to show further upside in the near future, which could constrain MOL's performance.
"Versus the Hungarian equity market, MOL's share price looks stretched at 15 times 1997 earnings per share -- 15 percent above the market average of 13 times, excluding Matav," the report said.
On the Budapest stock exchange MOL closed up 245 at 4335 forints.
